sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.team_id, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM nba_analysis.TRANSFORMED.local_team_game_facts f
  WHERE f.season = 2017 AND f.team_won
  GROUP BY f.team_id
)
SELECT w.team_id, t.team_abbreviation, w.wins
FROM w
LEFT JOIN nba_analysis.TRANSFORMED.dim_teams_cleansed t ON t.team_id = w.team_id
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY w.wins DESC) = 1
ORDER BY t.team_abbreviation

WITH wins AS (
  SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM nba_analysis.TRANSFORMED.local_team_game_facts
  WHERE season = 2018 AND team_won
  GROUP BY team_id
),
top AS (
  SELECT team_id, wins
  FROM wins
  WHERE wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM wins)
)
SELECT t.team_id, d.team_nickname, d.head_coach, t.wins
FROM top t
LEFT JOIN nba_analysis.TRANSFORMED.dim_teams_cleansed d ON d.team_id = t.team_id
ORDER BY t.team_id

sql:
SELECT
  g.player_id,
  g.player_name,
  ROUND(SUM(g.points) / COUNT(*), 2) AS points_per_game
FROM nba_analysis.TRANSFORMED.local_player_game_facts AS g
JOIN nba_analysis.TRANSFORMED.dim_teams_cleansed AS t
  ON g.opponent_team_id = t.team_id
WHERE LOWER(g.player_name) = 'lebron james'
  AND LOWER(t.city) = 'boston'
  AND LOWER(t.team_nickname) = 'celtics'
  AND g.participated = TRUE
GROUP BY g.player_id, g.player_name
